description: All vouchers of the store carrying the declared account's UserId, any restriction (one row per account), min..max. Outputs: voucherCount, first row asc/desc by name, start date, expiration date, amount, remaining. KB: Managing Vouchers.

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId the vouchers carry (ZnodeGiftCard.UserId): link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId), never a username. Left out (verification only): any owner

minVouchers.description: Fewest vouchers the account must carry on the store (2 for distinct sort anchors)

maxVouchers.description: Most vouchers the account may carry on the store (64: all on one page)

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode); a voucher belongs to one store
